incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - Windward (private VPC) — NLB healthchecks failing for egress path, 60% of probes returning 502 over last 5m. Paging oncall.
oncall-jess: I'm on it. Any customer-facing impact reported?
support-lead: Windward reports elevated request latencies and a few 502s for inference requests hitting their dedicated pool. They're seeing task queueing in their app.
sam-net: Observing NLB target group showing ~70% unhealthy in us-west-2-prv1. Healthcheck is TCP 443 -> connection reset. No change in SGs in the last 24h per config history.
priya-se: Can we reroute traffic to their ALB fallback? They have ALB in same VPC as a warm standby for egress.
mike-ops: Suggest a temporary traffic split via Route53 weighted DNS if we need to shift. Need approval from SRE to touch DNS weight.
eve-sre: Ok to adjust DNS weight to 20% ALB / 80% NLB as quick mitigation. Will monitor error rate. Priya, can you confirm ALB accepts same client certs/proxies?
priya-se: ALB accepts. We need to add header rewrite for X-Forwarded-For — I'll patch config. ETA ~6m.
oncall-jess: Running tcpdump on egress ENIs to validate reset source. Command: ```sudo tcpdump -i eth0 port 443 -c 200 -w /tmp/windward_443.pcap``` will attach shortly.
sam-net: Quick check: backend instances show SYN then RST from target IPs (10.2.11.x). Could be backend process overwhelmed. Scaling events? No autoscale triggered.
mike-ops: I see a spike in conntrack for tenant vpc range, per host. Might be conntrack exhaustion causing resets. Increasing conntrack on the target hosts now. Patching sysctl: ```sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144```. 
support-lead: Notifying Windward: "We're investigating NLB healthchecks and applying a temporary traffic split to ALB while we mitigate. We'll update in 10 min." :phone:
eve-sre: DNS weight updated in Route53: windward.example.com weight -> ALB 20, NLB 80. Propagation in progress. I'll keep watch on 1m error_rate metric.
priya-se: ALB config patch applied. Header rewrite in place.
sam-net: After conntrack bump, healthchecks improving on host 3/5 back to healthy. NLB target group unhealthy count dropping to 35%.
oncall-jess: Metrics: 1m 502 rate down from 60% -> 18% post-weight-change. Latency back to normal ranges for requests routed to ALB.
support-lead: Windward reports partial recovery on their side, but some long tail 502s for older connections. Asking if we should continue split or fully failover.
eve-sre: Keep split for now, monitor 15m. I'll run a rolling reboot on the two most impacted targets if unhealthy count bounces.
mike-ops: Rolling reboot scheduled for host-11 and host-12 in 5m. Will cordon traffic first: ```sudo systemctl stop inference-worker```
priya-se: If reboots don't stabilize, plan B is to spin up additional warm hosts in the dedicated pool and register them to target group.
support-lead: 👍 Windward thanks the team, asks for ETA for full resolution.
oncall-jess: ETA ~30-45m for full validation. Will update external status page. Incident note: cause appears to be conntrack exhaustion combined with bursty healthchecks; mitigation applied (conntrack bump + DNS weight + host reboots).
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1971. Runbook: private-vpc-egress -> conntrack -> host-evacuation. Handoff to postmortem channel in 2h for RCA.
